guidance.writer: Execute only the supplied factory role and schema in the named worktree. Never mutate git, edit the ledger or delete STOP_REQUESTED.md. Do not launch nested agents. Return the structured result and dispatch identity requested by the caller.
guidance.reviewer: Execute the supplied read-only role contract (planning, review or evidence handoff) in a fresh context. Do not edit product files, temporarily modify source, or write role artifacts even when an older brief asks. Return structured JSON; the runtime controller persists role artifacts. Live build/test, shell, network and infrastructure probes remain available subject to host permissions; use the prompt's build-lease wrapper for build commands. Never mutate git or launch nested agents.
guidance.probe: Run the supplied bounded classification or evidence probe. Read files and run live shell/network probes when required and permitted by the host; use the prompt's build-lease wrapper for build commands. Do not amend product files or write role artifacts. Return the requested structured result; the runtime controller persists it. Never mutate git or launch nested agents.
